title: EU should tax gambling and crypto to help farmers in next budget, Spanish socialist MEP says
lede: As EU leaders wrangle over Europe’s next long-term budget, socialist MEP Sandra Gómez López warns that unless Big Tech, online gambling, and crypto start paying more, farmers and poorer regions will be the ones footing the bill.

title: The same EU Parliament that built the Ethics Body is now killing it, in violation of European law
lede: Two and a half years after signing the agreement, the EU Parliament is blocking its own ethics body before it has met even once, but EU law does not allow it to walk away so easily, and nor should parliament president Metsola.
